subject: Alex Rivera — interview logistics, mic check & quiet-suite request
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@gmail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-08T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Interview on Nov 15 — time options & quick logistics

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for applying and for speaking with our recruiter last week. We'd love to schedule your onscreen loop for Monday, Nov 15. Below are two option blocks — let me know which you prefer and if any adjustments are needed:

Option A (preferred): 10:00 AM — 12:15 PM PT (technical loop + break + manager chat)
Option B: 1:30 PM — 3:45 PM PT

We will run the loop via Zoom. Tentative agenda (finalized after you pick a slot):
- 10:00–10:10 AM: Welcome + recruiter check-in (Zoom)
- 10:10–11:00 AM: System design (interviewer: Grace O'Connor)
- 11:00–11:30 AM: Algorithmic coding (pairing link provided)
- 11:30–11:45 AM: Break
- 11:45–12:15 PM: Hiring manager conversation (Karthik)

If you have any accessibility needs — live captions, extra breaks, quiet room at our SF office, or an interpreter — please tell me and we'll make arrangements.

Attaching an .ics for Option A and your resume placeholder request in case you need to forward.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop | Senior Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Attachments: 2027-11-15-Alex-Rivera-itinerary.ics, Alex_Rivera_Resume.pdf

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@gmail.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-08T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interview on Nov 15 — time options & quick logistics

Hi Lauren,

Thanks — Option A at 10:00 AM works best for me. A few accessibility requests: 
- Could you enable live captions on the Zoom link? I rely on captions for long technical sections.
- If possible, I'd prefer a quiet-suite/room for my onsite preparation and to join the Zoom (I have some auditory sensitivity).
- Also, a short 10-minute buffer between the coding and manager chat would be helpful.

I've attached a filled access form per your instructions. Happy to provide any other info.

Best,
Alex Rivera

Attachment: access_request_form.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Reservations Team <reservations@venueco.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-08T13:40:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Quiet suite reserve + live captioning for candidate on Nov 15 (Alex Rivera)

Hi Reservations / Workspace Team,

We're interviewing a candidate, Alex Rivera, on Monday Nov 15 (start 10:00 AM PT). Candidate has requested a quiet suite to join the Zoom call from our SF office and live captions enabled on the meeting. Can you please confirm availability for:

- Quiet Suite A (Level 5) reserved 9:30 AM — 12:30 PM PT
- On-site laptop + HDMI desk not required — candidate will join on their own laptop, but please confirm headset availability if requested
- Enable live captions on the Zoom meeting and provide instructions or a local captioner if automated captions are insufficient

Grace — heads-up that you'll get the pairing link for the coding portion. If we need additional time buffers, please let me know; candidate asked for 10 minutes between sessions.

I attached the candidate's access form. Please reply once room and captioning are confirmed.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Applied ML
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: access_request_form.docx

From: Reservations Team <reservations@venueco.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-09T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Quiet suite reserve + live captioning for candidate on Nov 15 (Alex Rivera)

Hi Karthik / Lauren,

Quiet Suite A is confirmed for Mon Nov 15, 9:30 AM — 12:30 PM PT. We will place a "Reserved — Candidate Interview" sign and a headset (noise-cancelling) in the room.

Captioning options: our Zoom tenant supports automated live captions by default; if you prefer human captioning, we can contract a captioner for the 10:00–12:15 window at $75/hr. Let us know which you prefer — otherwise we'll enable auto captions and provide the local instructions.

I've also provisioned an internal Wifi passcode guest token and uploaded the reservation confirmation to the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcExampleCandidateFolder (see file: reservation_nov15_quietsuiteA.pdf)

Thanks,
Reservations Team
reservations@venueco.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@gmail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-10T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Final confirmation — Monday 11/15 10:00 AM PT (itinerary + Zoom + accommodations)

Hi Alex — final details below, thanks for confirming Option A.

Interview date/time: Monday, Nov 15, 2027 — 10:00 AM to ~12:15 PM PT
Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890?pwd=example (passcode in calendar invite)
Live captions: automated captions will be enabled by default. Please tell me by Friday EOD if you want a live human captioner and we'll arrange at our expense.
Quiet suite: Quiet Suite A (5th floor) reserved 9:30 AM — 12:30 PM PT. Headset available at the room. Front desk will escort you — show your ID and say you are with Redwood Inference.
Agenda (final):
- 10:00–10:10 AM: Welcome + recruiter check-in (Lauren) 
- 10:10–11:00 AM: System design (Grace) — Zoom recording off, captions on
- 11:00–11:30 AM: Coding (pairing link will be posted in Slack channel #interviews)
- 11:30–11:40 AM: Buffer / restroom
- 11:40–12:10 PM: Manager conversation (Karthik)
- 12:10–12:15 PM: Quick close + next steps (Lauren)

Attachments included: itinerary .ics, copy of resume we have on file, and your submitted access form. If anything changes or you have last-minute needs, reply to this thread or call my cell at (415) 555-0198.

Good luck — we'll see you Monday!

Best,
Lauren
Senior Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
